_comment: Source colour -> house-palette placeholder map for normalize.py. Exact match first (hex normalised to lowercase #rrggbb, or a CSS colour name); anything not listed here falls back to the hue rule in 'fallback'. Placeholders are substituted with the real palette at render time (resolve.py): {{ink}} #1c1c1c, {{red}} #d9481f, {{blue}} #2b5ea7. White that was a background becomes transparent; the scene HTML supplies the #f6f1e7 paper.

fallback._comment: Hue rule for any colour with no exact entry. Convert the colour to HSL; near-white (lightness >= 0.97 and saturation < 0.1) becomes transparent (it was a background); near-black / low-saturation colours become {{ink}}; the rest are classified by hue: warm hues (red/orange/yellow/pink, hue < 50 or hue >= 330) -> {{red}}, cool hues (green/teal/blue/purple, 50 <= hue < 330) -> {{blue}}.
